description: This file defines options and methods for JWT authentication in the etcd server, including parsing keys, setting defaults, and handling different signing methods.

methods.name: ParseWithDefaults
methods.description: Loads options from a map, setting default TTL if not specified.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Loads options from a map, reading key files and setting signing method.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the appropriate signing key based on the selected signing method.

methods.name: hmacKey
methods.description: Returns the HMAC key for signing.

methods.name: rsaKey
methods.description: Returns RSA private or public key for signing or verification.

methods.name: ecKey
methods.description: Returns ECDSA private or public key for signing or verification.

methods.name: edKey
methods.description: Returns Ed25519 private or public key for signing or verification.
